title: The Plains Ablaze (1801–1821)
description: A campaign spanning the turn of the 19th century through the fur trade wars and the merger. Features the Lewis and Clark expedition and potential escalation into full-scale U.S. military retaliation across the Plains.

happens.subject: American expedition on the Missouri
happens.text: Captains Lewis and Clark have set out from St. Louis with an armed Corps of Discovery. They aim for the Pacific. Keep your traders watchful; their presence threatens our western posts.

happens.subject: American activity in the west
happens.text: Word from Washington indicates an American overland party is ascending the Missouri. Protect the Company's interests and trade routes.

beats.title: The Lewis and Clark Expedition departs St. Louis

happens.why: rumors of the Lewis and Clark massacre

happens.subject: The Corps of Discovery wiped out
happens.text: Disaster on the upper river: Captains Lewis and Clark and their entire command have been ambushed and slaughtered. Rumors are spreading that British traders supplied the weapons.

happens.subject: Massacre of the American expedition
happens.text: Word has arrived that the American officers Lewis and Clark are dead along with their men. The Plains nations are in total upheaval.

beats.title: The Lewis and Clark Expedition is destroyed

happens.why: US Army punitive invasion of the Plains

happens.subject: American invasion of the interior
happens.text: Washington is outraged over the slaughter of Lewis and Clark. A massive U.S. Army force under General Wilkinson has entered the Missouri basin with orders to show no mercy. They are burning camps, hanging suspect traders, and commandeering all pemmican and horses across the Plains.

happens.subject: American War on the Plains
happens.text: American troops have turned the Western Plains into a warzone in revenge for their lost officers. They attack all indigenous groups without distinction and confiscate British trade goods. Protect our posts and avoid engagement.

beats.title: U.S. Army launches a scorched-earth punitive invasion on the Plains

happens.why: plundering army drives trade to collapse

happens.subject: Plains trade destroyed by U.S. Dragoons
happens.text: American columns are pillaging every village and brigade in sight to supply their campaign. Native fur hunters have been scattered or killed, and our provision supply lines are completely severed.

happens.subject: Desperate refugees and military raids
happens.text: Thousands of displaced people are fleeing North from the U.S. army's war on the Missouri. American patrols cross into northern river routes at will to seize supplies.

beats.title: The Plains warzone halts trade and provision supplies
The Continental Blockade holds the fur market down

happens.subject: Lord Selkirk's grant
happens.text: The Committee has granted Lord Selkirk a hundred and sixteen thousand square miles on the Red River for a settlement. Settlers will come out by the Bay. Give them every assistance; the Canadians will not like it.

beats.title: Lord Selkirk's grant of Assiniboia (the Red River Colony)

happens.subject: war with the Americans
happens.text: The Americans have declared war. Michilimackinac is in danger and the canoes may be wanted for the King's service.

happens.subject: the American war
happens.text: Britain is at war with the United States. The ship may be late; ration accordingly.

beats.title: War between Britain and the United States

happens.subject: Astoria is ours
happens.text: Astor's men on the Columbia have sold out to us. Fort Astoria is Fort George now, and many of his clerks are Nor'Westers.

beats.title: Astor's Fort Astoria sold to the North West Company (Fort George)

happens.subject: the Pemmican Proclamation
happens.text: Macdonell has forbidden any provisions to leave the colony's lands. Our brigades eat pemmican or they do not run. The partners will not stand it.

happens.subject: the governor's proclamation
happens.text: Governor Macdonell has proclaimed that no pemmican may be taken out of Assiniboia. The Nor'Westers are furious; keep your people close.

pressure.why: word that the colony's governor means to stop the pemmican

happens.subject: the colony broken up
happens.text: The settlers at Red River have been driven off and their houses burned. Some are coming down to the Bay.

pressure.why: the Métis gathering against the colony

beats.title: The Red River Colony attacked and dispersed

happens.subject: Seven Oaks
happens.text: Governor Semple is dead with twenty of the colonists, shot down at Seven Oaks by Grant's half-breeds. The colony is gone.

happens.subject: Seven Oaks
happens.text: Grant's people met Semple at Seven Oaks. Semple is dead and the colony scattered. There will be a reckoning for this in Montreal.

pressure.why: Cuthbert Grant's riders on the Assiniboine

beats.title: The Battle of Seven Oaks: Governor Semple and twenty colonists killed

happens.subject: Fort William taken
happens.text: Selkirk came up the lakes with his de Meurons and took Fort William. McGillivray and the partners are under arrest.

beats.title: Lord Selkirk marches on Fort William and arrests the partners

happens.subject: the union of the companies
happens.text: The Company and the North West Company are joined under the Company's charter. Mr. George Simpson will govern the Northern Department. Expect economies.

happens.subject: the coalition
happens.text: It is done: the North West Company goes into the Hudson's Bay Company. The wintering partners are to be chief factors and chief traders. Many of the men will be let go.

beats.title: The union of the Hudson's Bay and North West Companies
